answer: Each identity posts a bond vesting at glacier pace and earns only from verified grading: each epoch it scores dealt samples of peer output, committed before reveal. A prism of a scoring rule splits reports into accuracy bands against matured consensus; only the violet band, scores consensus confirms, earns; off-band reports lose bond. Clones gain no cheap edge: each new key posts its own bond and judges honestly; mutual praise misses the band. Rigging needs a bonded majority, so cost grows per key at risk. Assumes scoreable samples and an honest bonded majority; a richer attacker buys one.
